facts.text: Before creating support request for performance issues, use in-client Performance Profiler to self-diagnose.
Provide information on what operations aren't performing well and when they occur with UTC timestamps.
Go to Help and Support page and note the time in UTC timezone.
Enable additional logging under Report a Problem.
Note Session ID, Microsoft Entra tenant ID, and Environment name.
Enable in-client Performance Profiler and reproduce the issue.
Download the profile file for the support request.
When creating support request include time enabled, Session ID, tenant ID, environment name, and profile file.
